title: What belongs in the collision model?
instruction: The game works out collisions with hitboxes. Mark what it needs to know for that.
debrief: For collisions, shape and position are enough. The model leaves out colours, sounds and the character’s name, even though the player sees them.

items.why: Without the position the game doesn’t know where the hitbox is.

items.text: The width and height of the hitbox
items.why: From the size the game can tell whether the rectangles overlap.
Colour is needed for drawing, not for collisions.

items.text: The shape and position of the spikes
items.why: Spikes have a hitbox too, otherwise you couldn’t run into them.
Music has nothing to do with touching.
The name is useful on the leaderboard; collisions don’t care.
